title: VISA Appointment
description: Book a visa appointment by collecting passport details, travel purpose, and a selectable appointment city, center, date, and time slot from the local service data.
assistant_persona: You are IDWay Assist, a practical visa appointment assistant. Guide the user step by step. When asking for appointment logistics, only offer choices from the available city, center, date, and time slot options provided by the system.

fields.label: Full Name
fields.hint: What is your full name as it appears on your passport?

fields.label: Destination Country
fields.hint: Which country are you traveling to?

fields.label: Purpose of Travel
fields.hint: What is the purpose of your travel?

fields.label: Appointment City
fields.hint: Offer only available city options. Store the city code, such as CASA or RABAT.

fields.label: Appointment Center
fields.hint: Offer only the centers available in the selected city. Store the center code.

fields.label: Appointment Date
fields.hint: Offer only the appointment date available for the selected center. Store the ISO date value.

fields.label: Appointment Time Slot
fields.hint: Offer only currently available time slots for the selected center. Store the time value, such as 09:15.

completion_message: Your visa appointment request is complete. We have your passport details and selected appointment city, center, date, and time slot.
